ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that intercepts data pipeline failures, queries lineage graphs to find downstream impact, generates verified repair pull requests, and writes the resolution back to metadata hubs.
ideas.title: DataHub-Sentinel: Autonomous Incident Response for Modern Data Stacks
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the winning strategy of the DataHub Agent Hackathon by solving high-friction data engineering incidents with automated agent loops and write-back functionality.

ideas.pitch: A multimodal platform that ingests raw video feeds, extracts visual events and text using vector embeddings, and transforms unstructured footage into instantly searchable analytical databases.
ideas.title: QueryVison: Unstructured Video Intelligence Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven formula of turning complex unstructured data into accessible, queryable datasets that capture high scores for practical enterprise utility.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent pipeline that converts raw CSV or SQL queries directly into fully formatted Tableau dashboards within seconds using the Tableau REST API and automated data profiling.
ideas.title: AutoTableau-Stream: Natural Language Dashboard Synthesizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning blueprint of the Tableau DataDev Hackathon by drastically cutting down visualization creation time through direct API automation.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance RAG and auto-embedding toolkit built specifically for MariaDB, allowing developers to index and query unstructured documents with optimized HNSW vector search.
ideas.title: MariaDB-SeamlessRAG: Toon-Native Auto-Embedding Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on sponsor-specific technology integration, following the exact strategy that won 2nd place at the MariaDB Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A frontend analytics dashboard providing real-time battery health monitoring, degradation predictions, and digital twin visualization using React, Vite, and predictive REST endpoints.
ideas.title: VoltTwin: AI-Powered Battery Intelligence & Predictive Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the successful pattern of building robust predictive data visualization frontends for IoT and industrial digital twin monitoring.
